stem.text: Spheres X and Y form an isolated system. The mass of Y is greater than the mass of X.
Sphere X collides elastically with sphere Y.
The speed of sphere X before the collision is $u$.

A.text: Sphere X rebounds with a speed that is greater than $u$, and sphere Y moves off with a speed that is less than $u$.

B.text: Sphere X rebounds with a speed that is less than $u$, and sphere Y moves off with a speed that is also less than $u$.

C.text: Sphere X rebounds with speed $u$, and sphere Y remains stationary.

D.text: Sphere X remains stationary, and sphere Y moves off with a speed that is less than $u$.
